mapper.sql: select a.user_id, a.account, a.user_name, a.email, TO_BASE64(a.avatar) as avatar, TO_BASE64(a.full_avatar) as full_avatar, a.phone, a.phone_cipher, a.phone_secret_key, a.password_hash, a.sex, a.age, a.address, a.employee_no, a.id_card, a.id_card_cipher, a.id_card_secret_key, a.education, a.status, a.is_del, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.order_num as role_order_num, r.status as role_status from sys_user a left join sys_user_role ur on a.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct a.user_id, a.account, a.user_name, a.email, a.phone, a.status, a.create_time from sys_user a left join sys_user_role ur on a.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where a.is_del = 0 and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and a.user_id not in (select a2.user_id from sys_user a2 inner join sys_user_role ur2 on a2.user_id = ur2.user_id and ur2.role_id = #{roleId})
AND (a.account like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') OR a.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
AND a.phone like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
select a.user_id, a.account from sys_user a where a.account = #{userName} and a.is_del = 0 limit 1
select a.user_id, a.phone from sys_user a where a.is_del = 0 and a.phone is not null and a.phone != '' and #{phonenumber} is not null and #{phonenumber} != '' and a.phone = #{phonenumber} limit 1
select a.user_id, a.email from sys_user a where a.email = #{email} and a.is_del = 0 limit 1
